them.zh: 这套 skill 让 Codex 做的

steps.en: Copy the skill folders into Codex's skills directory
steps.zh: 把 skill 文件夹拷进 Codex 的 skills 目录

steps.en: Each folder's SKILL.md description tells Codex when that skill applies
steps.zh: 每个文件夹的 SKILL.md 描述告诉 Codex 这个 skill 何时适用

steps.en: Ask Codex for Apple-platform work as usual, e.g. split a long SwiftUI view
steps.zh: 照常派 Apple 平台的活，比如拆一个过长的 SwiftUI 视图

steps.en: Loads the matching skill and its reference notes
steps.zh: 加载匹配的 skill 和它附带的参考资料

steps.en: Applies its house rules: small subview types, MV over MVVM, a fixed property order
steps.zh: 按其中的规矩改：拆成小的子视图类型、MV 优先于 MVVM、固定的属性顺序

value.en: Codex applies one experienced iOS developer's SwiftUI and Swift conventions without you retyping them each time
value.zh: Codex 照着一位资深 iOS 开发者的 SwiftUI / Swift 习惯干活，不用你每次重敲

sources: https://github.com/Dimillian/Skills README — Install: place these skill folders under `$CODEX_HOME/skills`; Skills table (16 skills); Usage (each skill's SKILL.md holds triggers, workflow, examples, references)
swiftui-view-refactor/SKILL.md (description triggers; View ordering; Default to MV, not MVVM; prefer dedicated subview types) + references/ folder
